note: Consulted by the researcher; SynthProvenance never fetches these URLs. See docs/SYNTHID_RESEARCH_SOURCES.md.

sources.title: SynthID - Google DeepMind
sources.relevance: Modalities (image, video, audio, text); Gemini verification pathway; Detector portal tested with journalists; no public image API or open-source image detector mentioned.

sources.title: SynthID Detector - a new portal to help identify AI-generated content
sources.relevance: Announced 2025-05-20; rollout to early testers via waitlist; no API or SDK mentioned.

sources.title: SynthID Detector waitlist (closed)
sources.relevance: No longer accepting responses; states verification is generally available via the Gemini app and the Detector remains for media professionals.

sources.title: SynthID Detector & Backstory onboarding form
sources.relevance: Current portal access: active journalists / verification professionals with a corporate Google-linked account. Portal URL not public.

sources.title: How we're bringing AI image verification to the Gemini app
sources.relevance: 2025-11-20: image verification in the Gemini app; C2PA metadata on Nano Banana Pro images.

sources.title: You can now verify Google AI-generated videos in the Gemini app
sources.relevance: 2025-12-18: video verification added (100 MB / 90 s limits).

sources.title: Verify AI-generated images, videos, and audio (Gemini Apps Help)
sources.relevance: Official procedure and limits (~10 image checks per 24 h, 100 MB); recognises only Google AI content; 'not detected' does not exclude other AI systems.

sources.title: Gemini
sources.relevance: User-facing verification pathway (browser, Google account, manual upload).

sources.title: Making it easier to understand how content was created and edited
sources.relevance: 2026-05-19: verification expanding to Search and Chrome; AI Content Detection API announced for trusted partners. Chrome rollout completion UNVERIFIED.

sources.title: Detect AI-generated images (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)
sources.relevance: Private Preview by application; page body did not load; whether it reads SynthID specifically is UNVERIFIED. Not integrated (cloud upload).

sources.title: Verify an image watermark (Vertex AI, Imagen)
sources.relevance: Returns HTTP 404; former Imagen watermark verification preview treated as retired.

sources.title: Gemini API: image generation
sources.relevance: States generated images include a SynthID watermark; documents no verification method.

sources.title: google-deepmind/synthid-text
sources.relevance: Only open-source SynthID code; TEXT watermarking only, not for production; not applicable to images.

sources.title: SynthID Text (Google AI for Developers)
sources.relevance: Production SynthID Text in Hugging Face Transformers 4.46.0+; text only.

sources.title: SynthID-Image: Image watermarking at internet scale (Gowal et al.)
sources.relevance: v1 2025-10-10; describes deployment at >10 billion images/frames and SynthID-O evaluation; no code, weights or detector released; verification for trusted testers / partners.

sources.title: Nano Banana 2
sources.relevance: 2026-02-26: SynthID paired with interoperable C2PA Content Credentials.

sources.title: Learn about AI labels & content credentials (Google Docs Help)
sources.relevance: Gemini output in Workspace carries Content Credentials signed as Google Media Processing Services.

sources.title: contentauth/c2pa-rs
sources.relevance: Rust C2PA SDK, 0.x beta, v0.91.1 (2026-09-27); local signature/trust validation for the separate C2PA layer.

sources.title: contentauth/c2pa-python
sources.relevance: Python binding (PyPI 0.38.0, 2026-09-29, Windows wheels); optional c2pa-python engine already supported by SynthProvenance.

sources.title: GenImage dataset
sources.relevance: AI-image detection benchmark; contains no SynthID-marked images; usable only as negative/other-generator controls.

sources.title: Synthbuster
sources.relevance: 9,000 images from 9 generators; no SynthID; other-generator controls.

sources.title: CNNDetection / ForenSynths
sources.relevance: GAN-era detection dataset; no SynthID; historical controls.

sources.title: Rinne414/SynthID-detector (third-party)
sources.relevance: Named in the research brief. Not inspected, not executed and not integrated: third-party reverse-engineering candidates are out of scope; no validated local SynthID detector exists per official sources.
